narrNote: VARR is on NARR's official affiliate list and is a DBHDS credentialing entity under Va. Code § 37.2-431.1 (state certification of recovery residences mandatory since July 1, 2025); varronline.org opened and content-verified in-run. WARNING: the look-alike domain varr.org is PARKED and listed for sale at GoDaddy — do not link it; the real VARR site is varronline.org.
notes: Virginia's local layer is its 40 Community Services Boards (confirmed on the verified DBHDS homepage); the linked official state PDF maps every CSB to its counties/cities by DBHDS region. Medicaid SUD benefit = ARTS (Addiction and Recovery Treatment Services) — DMAS ARTS page opened and verified in-run. BACKFILL 2026-10-22: the original DMAS ARTS URL (dmas.virginia.gov/for-providers/addiction-and-recovery-treatment-services/) returned 404 after the DMAS website restructure; medicaidSud now points to the current ARTS page (for-providers/benefits-services-for-providers/behavioral-health/addiction-and-recovery-treatment-services/), fetch-verified live on 2026-10-22 with matching ARTS overview content. Crisis: five regional crisis hubs contract Regional Crisis Call Centers answering 988 24/7 under the Marcus Alert system (DBHDS crisis page content confirmed via the official page's search result; a direct re-fetch was rate-limited). BACKFILL 2026-10-22: agency phone is now (804) 786-3921, DBHDS's published main number, confirmed on DBHDS's own State Board page on dbhds.virginia.gov and on the Commonwealth's virginia.gov agency listing. peerOrgs backfilled — all three candidates fetch-verified live on 2026-10-22: SAARA of Virginia (statewide recovery community organization; saara.org), McShin Foundation (CAPRSS-accredited recovery community organization based in Richmond serving statewide; mcshin.org), and VOCAL Virginia (statewide peer-run mental health advocacy network; vocalvirginia.org).
